bio: CASE FILE: R1-CALLAHAN. Suspect is considered one of the Rockport Police Department’s highest-priority street racing suspects and the acting ringleader of the Blacklist syndicate. Originally operating a heavily modified black Ford Mustang GT before unlawfully acquiring a customized BMW M3 GTR through mechanical sabotage during an organized street race, the suspect quickly rose through the Blacklist rankings using intimidation, fraudulent race wins, and aggressive pursuit evasion tactics. The suspect demonstrates high-risk driving behavior during pursuits and is known to provoke officers into extended high-speed engagements to build notoriety among local racers.
